notApplicable.selected-focus-visible: The focus-visible case uses native Tab and ArrowRight to select and focus Week; it already captures the selected keyboard-focus surface.
notApplicable.density: Density belongs to the containing collection. Segmented geometry follows size without changing the selected value.
notApplicable.error: Segmented has no field-validation appearance; the owning field provides validation text.
notApplicable.loading: Async view loading belongs to the selected content region.
